newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen firm.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen firm.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.12 up at 40.15 to the dollar on Wednesday in the kerb market amid a rise in supply of the U.S. currency from abroad, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to open higher on Thursday as most weak holders would like to book profits around these levels.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 9.0 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
